requestPrompt.noteSelfAlone: स्वीकारल्यावर दोन्ही प्रोफाइल एकमेकांसाठी खुली होतात.

screenGuard.message: प्रत्येक कुटुंबाचे फोटो आणि माहिती खाजगी राहावी म्हणून मंगल्यमध्ये स्क्रीनशॉट घेण्याची परवानगी नाही.

deleteData.title: Delete everything Mangalya holds about you
deleteData.deleted: This deletes at once, for good: your profile, photos, voice clip, documents, horoscope details, preferences, Home Circle, requests, messages you wrote, shortlist, notes, plan records, and any agent or client lists. Profiles you made for a child who has not taken them over go too.
deleteData.retained: Kept without your name, phone or any text: safety reports, moderation records and paid-order records the law or other families' safety require.
deleteData.kept: Your ForKhatri account and your other modules stay. You can come back to Mangalya later as a brand-new member. This cannot be undone.
deleteData.done: Your Mangalya data is deleted. Taking you back to ForKhatri.
deleteData.error: Could not delete just now. Please try again.
deleteData.limited: Too many attempts. Please try again in an hour.
deleteData.role: This account holds a moderator role. Ask an owner to remove it first.
